name: cooling-point-website
description: M/S. Cooling Point: static marketing website (HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 5.3, GSAP, AOS, Swiper).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:bootstrap
scripts.build:css: cat assets/css/style.css assets/css/animations.css assets/css/responsive.css | esbuild --loader=css --minify --target=es2019,chrome90,safari14 --log-level=warning > assets/css/site.min.css
